entity.name: Miami Grand Prix
entity.summary: South Florida Motorsports promotes the Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix, staged on a temporary circuit at the Miami International Autodrome within the Hard Rock Stadium complex in Miami Gardens. It makes money through grandstand and Paddock Club ticketing, premium hospitality, title sponsorship and branded hospitality areas.
businessUnits: The Grand Prix: the Formula 1 race weekend, including a Sprint in 2024, Formula 2 debut in 2026 and Porsche Carrera Cup sessions
Miami International Autodrome: five FIA Grade One configurations, including the 5.41km Grand Prix circuit and the Marina and MIA loops
Branded hospitality areas: Hard Rock's Beach Club outside Turns 11 to 13, being revamped for 2027
Other events on the circuit: Formula E Miami E-Prix, held January 31, 2026, with a 2027 edition listed

keyDates.label: Otro Capital reported in advanced talks to buy a 20% stake from Stephen Ross (pending, not finalized)
Formula 1 Miami Grand Prix sixth edition (April 30 to May 2, 2027)
Event officially renamed Formula 1 Hard Rock Miami Grand Prix from the 2027 race
Stephen Ross became Chairman and Owner of the race
Formula E Miami E-Prix held at the autodrome

audiences: Ticket buyers and attendees (275,799 over three days in 2024; sold out each of its first five editions)
Premium and corporate hospitality buyers (Paddock Club and suites)
Sponsors and partners such as Hard Rock and Crypto.com
Industry audience, including a race-week Autosport Business Exchange edition
Local community, including community programs and student engagement
aliases: Formula 1 Hard Rock Miami Grand Prix

relationship.summary: No public Flowcode case study found; the Miami Grand Prix appears only as the setting of a 2023 Jonas Brothers activation blog post, and no sibling owner, league, or venue relationship was confirmed.

summary.headline: With Hard Rock taking the title in 2027, the Paddock Club growing to about 9,000 tickets and a new Grandstand Membership launching, the Miami Grand Prix is reprinting and repackaging nearly every fan touchpoint for April 30 to May 2, and each one can capture first-party data and drive revenue.
bullets: Hard Rock International replaces Crypto.com as title partner from 2027 under a multi-year naming deal (reported, unconfirmed, as eight figures a year). That means a full rebrand of event signage and the Fan Fest.

Premium inventory is expanding. A permanent 115,000 sq ft Paddock Club extension raises capacity from about 6,000 to about 9,000 tickets, Paddock Club is on public sale for the first time, and the Hard Rock Beach Club is being revamped.

Retention is being productized. Grandstand+ presented by Heineken now requires auto-renewal enrollment, buyers who renew by 12/31 become inaugural members, and eight team-specific grandstands debut in 2027.

signals.title: Hard Rock becomes title partner from 2027
signals.summary: South Florida Motorsports and Hard Rock International announced a multi-year naming-rights agreement on 2026-09-01. The event becomes the Formula 1 Hard Rock Miami Grand Prix from the 2027 race, replacing Crypto.com, which held the rights since 2022.

signals.title: Hard Rock Beach Club revamp for 2027
signals.summary: The Hard Rock Beach Club outside Turns 11-13 will be revamped for 2027, with live performances, cabanas with track views and food and beverage. Hard Rock will keep producing live entertainment at the track. Design and capacity details have not been disclosed.

signals.title: Title deal value unconfirmed
signals.summary: SponsorFlo cites a multi-year 'eight-figure annual commitment' attributed to Sportcal and puts an estimated $20-30M on the deal. The Sportcal text retrieved states no fee, so both figures are unconfirmed.

signals.title: 2027 tickets on sale; Paddock Club opened to public
signals.summary: South Florida Motorsports announced that 2027 tickets are on sale for the sixth Grand Prix, April 30-May 2, 2027, and said the race has sold out each of its first five editions. For the first time, Paddock Club tickets went on sale to the general public, starting September 24.

signals.title: 2027 Miami GP set for April 30-May 2
signals.summary: The 2027 race returns April 30-May 2 at the Miami International Autodrome. It is the sixth Grand Prix and part of a 24-race F1 calendar.

signals.title: 2027 grandstand pricing and entry prices
signals.summary: The official site lists Grandstand Pass at $845 (an earlier page version showed $785), Start/Finish Grandstand at $1,125 and Turn 1 North at $945. The homepage lists grandstands from $685, hospitality from $1,500 and Paddock Club from $16,500. Third parties say prices rose only marginally from 2026, and one source puts the cheapest 3-day seat at $695.

signals.title: 2027 hospitality price tiers
signals.summary: The official hospitality page lists the 72 Club at $8,000, MSC Yacht Club at $4,250, Turn 18 Club at $3,800 and Hard Rock Beach Club Deck at $1,500. It also lists an MSC Yacht Club Deck Pass.

signals.title: Eight team-specific grandstands in 2027
signals.summary: Miami will offer eight team-specific grandstands in 2027: Ferrari, Williams, Audi, McLaren, Red Bull, Haas, Cadillac and Racing Bulls. Grandstand Pass returns, letting fans sit in a different grandstand each day.

signals.title: Paddock Club expansion opens in 2027
signals.summary: A permanent 115,000 sq ft, three-storey Paddock Club extension runs from the start/finish straight to Turn 1. It takes the building from about 6,000 to about 9,000 tickets and the total footprint to 305,000 sq ft. It replaces the temporary Casa Tua Trackside Club and houses the Precision Drive Club. Tom Garfinkel announced it during 2026 race week.
signals.scale: 115,000 sq ft extension; capacity ~6,000 to ~9,000; 305,000 sq ft total

signals.title: Grandstand+ presented by Heineken and Grandstand Membership
signals.summary: Grandstand+ returns for 2027 as a free benefits program for 3-Day Grandstand buyers, who must enroll in auto-renewal after checkout. Benefits include Opening Night Kick-Off Party access, free parking, a Heineken Highline gondola ride, a 20% merch discount and 10% off 2028 tickets. Fans who renew or buy by 12/31 become inaugural members.

signals.title: Campus Pass deposits open, no 2027 price
signals.summary: The official page takes a $100 deposit per Campus Pass (general admission), presented by Ticketmaster. GPDestinations says all categories except Campus Passes are on sale. No 2027 Campus Pass price or on-sale date was found; general admission was $650 in 2026.

signals.title: Otro Capital in advanced talks for 20% stake
signals.summary: Front Office Sports reported on September 24, 2026 that Otro Capital is in advanced talks to buy a 20% stake in the race from Stephen Ross. No deal is finalized, the valuation is unknown, and the talks cover the race alone. The race sits in Ross Sports & Entertainment, formed in August 2026.

signals.title: F1 contract extended through 2041
signals.summary: F1 gave Miami a 10-year extension keeping the race on the calendar until at least 2041. F1 claims the race generated more than $1 billion in economic impact across its first three years.
signals.scale: $1 billion economic impact over first three years (F1 claim)

signals.title: Katharina Nowak leads as president
signals.summary: Nowak was named president in September 2025, succeeding Tyler Epp, who joined Cadillac. At 28 she is the youngest president of an F1 Grand Prix. The 2026 race was her first as president.

signals.title: Empower joins as Official Event Supporter
signals.summary: Empower announced a partnership on Jan. 28, 2026 as Official Event Supporter. It presents the Sunrise Key fan zone and is tied to Empower Vista at Turn 1. Tom Garfinkel said Empower is joining 'for years to come'.

signals.title: Waymo sponsors 2026 race
signals.summary: Waymo gained sponsorship rights for the 2026 race, with prominent circuit signage and a self-driving car display at Fan Fest. A report at the time cited 32 event partners.

signals.title: First Official Fan Fest at Lummus Park
signals.summary: The free Official Fan Fest debuted April 29-May 3, 2026 at Lummus Park, Miami Beach. It offered driver appearances, simulators and watch parties, with the Ticketmaster Stage, Ford Racing Simulators and Heineken 0.0 sampling bar among partner activations. No 2027 Fan Fest dates were found, though Hard Rock's deal covers branding of the Fan Fest.
signals.scale: Five days, free admission; up to 2 tickets per guest

signals.title: 2026 race attendance over 275,000, sold out
signals.summary: The sold-out fifth edition drew more than 275,000 spectators, similar to 2025. A Yahoo Sports columnist reported a smaller Saturday and perhaps half the expected Sunday crowd because of weather.

signals.title: 2026 campus redesign and MSC Yacht Club debut
signals.summary: The campus was remodeled around six Miami neighborhoods, each with local restaurants open to all ticket tiers. The MSC Yacht Club debuted as a new premium experience, and a reimagined Marina added a viewing deck and Lighthouse Lounge.

signals.title: 2026 brand activations across race weekend
signals.summary: Event Marketer counted 17 brand experiences and BizBash reported 50+ clubs, lounges and activations. Examples include the TikTok x Monster Energy Clubhouse (Monster reached more than 25,000 fans), Liquid I.V. sampling over 97,000 sticks and S.Pellegrino's Dinner Dialogues campaign with Lewis Hamilton. Heineken, Cadillac and Audi also ran activations.
signals.scale: 17 brand experiences (Event Marketer); 50+ activations (BizBash); 25,000+ fans (Monster); 97,000+ sticks (Liquid I.V.)

signals.title: PUMA and Esses creator and block-party activity
signals.summary: PUMA hosted content creators on-site and partnered with motorsport publication Esses. Esses, with Visa and Cash App, held a block party and car show at Riverside Studios.

signals.title: Apple TV broadcast debut and viewership dispute
signals.summary: 2026 was Apple's first season as F1's US broadcaster, reportedly at $150 million a year per Autosport. Apple's Eddy Cue said linear ratings were 'way up' early on. Samba data shows Miami household reach down 68% versus 2025, though Samba is not an official ratings provider. ABC's 2024 Miami coverage drew 3.1 million viewers.
signals.scale: Miami household reach down 68% (Samba); $150M/yr (Autosport understands); 3.1M viewers (ABC 2024)

signals.title: Sponsor out-of-home at Miami airport
signals.summary: JCDecaux documented partner and team-sponsor OOH at Miami International Airport around the race, including Heineken, Nestlé, TAG Heuer, Chivas Regal and Apple. OpenAI, IBM and TAG Heuer also reached private aviation terminals. These were sponsor-run, not Miami GP-run.

signals.title: Autosport Business Exchange race-week partnership
signals.summary: The Miami GP and Motorsport Network announced a race-week edition of Autosport Business Exchange, the first presented in official partnership with a Grand Prix. The next edition is also planned for Miami during race week.

signals.title: Miami E-Prix scheduled for Feb 20, 2027
signals.summary: Ticketmaster and AXS list the 2027 Google Cloud Miami E-Prix on February 20, 2027 at the Miami International Autodrome. Ticketmaster also lists Electric Lounge and Emotion Club hospitality.

signals.title: Miami GP named 2026 Promoter of the Year
signals.summary: The Miami Grand Prix was named 2026 Promoter of the Year at the Autosport Awards in London.

signals.title: Mobile ticketing, app and Fan Fest registration
signals.summary: The race site promotes a Miami Grand Prix app via QR code and directs fans to f1miamigp.com/app for mobile tickets. The 2026 Fan Fest required digital registration, with up to 2 tickets per guest. No CRM, data vendor or app vendor was confirmed on official pages.

signals.title: Amex presale and Hard Rock Unity touchpoints
signals.summary: American Express became official payments partner of Hard Rock Stadium, the Miami GP and the Dolphins, and Card Members got a grandstand presale from August 20 to 25 (a 2025 release for the 2026 cycle). Hard Rock's Unity loyalty program exists, but no integration with Miami GP ticketing, the app or the Beach Club has been announced. No Amex presale for 2027 was confirmed.

signals.title: Fan experience complaints and criticism
signals.summary: A UK fan said they 'paid for seats we couldn't actually use' because of blocked views. Beach Club performance access is not sold separately and cannot be added to standard tickets. Commentators describe the event as influencer-heavy and expensive; these are commentary pieces, not formal complaint data.

signals.title: MIA Shop and F1 Store Miami merchandise (2026-labelled)
signals.summary: The promoter's MIA Shop lists T-shirts at $60, a Quarter-Zip Jacket at $215 and a Helmet Crewneck at $100, with a 2026 race-period timestamp. The F1 Store lists Miami collab items including Disney, Cadillac Tommy Hilfiger and Audi adidas caps, and a $41.99 bucket hat. No 2027-specific merchandise launch was found.

opportunities.title: Make the 2027 Hard Rock title rebrand signage scannable and measurable before it goes to print
opportunities.businessUnit: The Grand Prix: the Formula 1 race weekend
opportunities.whatsHappening: Hard Rock signed a multi-year naming-rights deal announced 2026-09-01, and the event becomes the Formula 1 Hard Rock Miami Grand Prix from 2027, replacing Crypto.com. Hard Rock's deal also covers branding of the Fan Fest. Hard Rock's Unity loyalty program exists, but no integration with Miami GP ticketing, the app or the Beach Club has been announced.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: Title-partner signage across the campus and Fan Fest is being redesigned now. Branded dynamic Flowcodes printed once can route to different offers across race week, the E-Prix and future years without a reprint. FlowID and Analytics would give the promoter and Hard Rock person-level proof of what the title spend delivered. The Flowcode sports benchmark shows 75% higher than average conversion for first-party data collection.
play: Embed Hard Rock co-branded Flowcodes in title signage, the Fan Fest stage and campus wayfinding while 2027 artwork is still being produced.
Route scans by location and time: race-week offers, Beach Club upsells and Unity sign-up or linking (if Hard Rock is open to it).
Capture identity with FlowID, then sync to the promoter CRM and share agreed segments with Hard Rock.
Deliver a post-race title-partner ROI report covering scans, sign-ups and conversions by placement.
kpis: Unity or CRM sign-ups attributed to title assets

timing.window: Before 2027 title signage and Fan Fest production, ahead of April 30 race week

opportunities.buyer: Partnerships and sponsorship team at South Florida Motorsports, jointly with Hard Rock International's marketing team

timeliness.why: Rebrand artwork is being produced now

fit.why: Dynamic codes avoid reprints and prove partner value

access.why: Approvals are split between the promoter and Hard Rock

caveats: Whether Unity can integrate is unknown; validate with Hard Rock.
2027 Fan Fest dates have not been announced.

opportunities.title: Turn the eight team grandstands into an enrollment and merch channel for the new Grandstand Membership
opportunities.businessUnit: The Grand Prix: grandstand ticketing and Grandstand+
opportunities.whatsHappening: Grandstand+ presented by Heineken requires auto-renewal enrollment and gives benefits including a 20% merch discount and 10% off 2028 tickets. Buyers who renew by 12/31 become inaugural members. Eight team-specific grandstands debut in 2027, and the MIA Shop shows no 2027 merchandise launch yet.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: Team-themed grandstands are a natural place for seat-level codes that drop team merch, unlock member benefits and confirm renewals, all tied to the fan's identity. Flowcode's team builds the experiences, so the launch can be ready in time for race week.
play: Install a unique Flowcode in each team grandstand, linked to that team's merch and the member's benefits.
Use a FlowHub to show the member's perks, the 20% merch discount and 10% off 2028 tickets.
Use FlowID to capture team affinity and seat location for each fan.
Send team-segmented renewal and merch campaigns through the CRM after the race.

timing.window: Inaugural-member deadline Dec 31, then race week

opportunities.buyer: Ticketing and CRM lead; merchandise lead

timeliness.why: Membership launches with a Dec 31 deadline

caveats: An app QR and mobile ticketing already exist (S27); position Flowcode alongside them, not as a replacement.
Ticketmaster may run ticketing; integration with it needs validating.
Merch rights may sit partly with F1 Store and Fanatics.

issues: Eight team grandstands 'debuting' in 2027 is only implied by the truncated E13 list, not stated as a debut.
The claim that the MIA Shop shows no 2027 merchandise launch rests on the S30 signal; E67's undated 'Just Rolled In' items do not clearly show this.

opportunities.title: Drive in-seat upgrades and 2028 renewals across the expanded ~9,000-ticket Paddock Club
opportunities.whatsHappening: A permanent three-storey extension takes the Paddock Club from about 6,000 to about 9,000 tickets and houses the Precision Drive Club. Paddock Club tickets went on public sale for the first time on September 24, from $16,500. The hospitality tiers range from $1,500 to $8,000.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: Roughly 3,000 new seats, many sold to members of the public rather than corporate buyers, means more guests whose behavior on site is not tied back to ticketing. A question to validate: how does the team identify and upsell these guests on race day today? Flowcodes and FlowHubs on tables, menus and screens can sell upgrades and experiences and capture 2028 intent while guests are on site.
play: Place Flowcodes on table tents, menus and screens in the new building and the Precision Drive Club.
Use FlowHubs to sell upgrades such as yacht deck passes and Beach Club access, plus experiences and 2028 deposits.
Use FlowID to tie each scan to the ticket holder and flag high-intent guests to the sales team.
Follow up with personalized renewal offers before the 2028 on-sale.

timing.window: Before the new building's fit-out and signage are finalized for race week

opportunities.buyer: VP of Premium Hospitality and Paddock Club sales

timeliness.why: New building is being outfitted for 2027

caveats: The opening date of the extension has not been given.
The current hospitality CRM tooling is unknown.

issues: Three-storey height is not in the evidence snippets (only the 115,000 sq ft extension is shown).
The increase from about 6,000 to about 9,000 tickets is not visible in the evidence snippets.
The $16,500 Paddock Club price is not in any evidence snippet.
The $1,500 Beach Club Deck price is only in the signal, not in the truncated E48 snippet.

opportunities.title: Monetize live performances at the revamped Hard Rock Beach Club
opportunities.businessUnit: Branded hospitality areas: Hard Rock Beach Club
opportunities.whatsHappening: The Beach Club is being revamped for 2027 with live performances, cabanas with track views and food and beverage. Beach Club Deck tickets cost $1,500. Fans criticized that performance access is not sold separately and cannot be added to standard tickets.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: On-stage live reads and screen calls to action can sell performance access, cabana upgrades and F&B at the moment of attention. The Penguins drove 88% conversion and $8,000 in 30 minutes from in-arena live reads.
play: Run Flowcodes and FlowURLs on stage screens during sets, plus live reads from the host.
Point them to a FlowHub with add-on access, cabana upgrades and Hard Rock offers.
Capture identity with FlowID and track sales per performance.
Retarget scanners with 2028 Beach Club offers.

timing.window: During the 2027 Beach Club design process

opportunities.buyer: Hard Rock entertainment and hospitality team, with promoter hospitality

fit.why: Live-read commerce is a proven use case

caveats: Design and capacity have not been disclosed.
Selling add-on access is a pricing-policy decision the promoter would need to make.

issues: The fan criticism that performance access is not sold separately is not directly backed; E103 is about blocked views, and E104 is official site wording rather than criticism.
The $1,500 Beach Club Deck price is only in the signal, not in the truncated E48 snippet.

opportunities.title: Offer partners measured activation reporting across 50+ race-week activations
opportunities.whatsHappening: Reports count 32 partners and 17 to 50+ activations in 2026, including Monster reaching 25,000+ fans and Liquid I.V. sampling 97,000+ sticks. Empower joined 'for years to come' and presents the Sunrise Key fan zone.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: Partners report reach and sample counts. A question to validate: can the promoter show partners attributable conversions and data from their activations? A shared Workspace lets each partner run governed codes while the promoter keeps oversight and a consolidated report, which helps with sponsor renewals. C3 Presents logged 1.3M+ scans across its festivals.
play: Set up a promoter-managed Workspace with partner sub-accounts.
Give each activation its own Flowcodes and a FlowHub sampling sign-up.
Capture consented data, with promoter and partner sharing rules.
Deliver post-race partner reports for renewal conversations.
opportunities.buyer: Head of partnerships and partner servicing
caveats: Some activations are run by partner agencies with their own tools.

adjustments: 14 source domains, newest signal 7 mo old
